content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Manesar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Employees' State Insurance Corporation Hospital Manesar (ESIC Manesar) for filling various medical positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under ESIC Manesar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 31 vacancies available for positions including Full Time/Part Time Contractual Specialists, Senior Residents, and Part Time Contractual Super-Specialists.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline via a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications.

faq.question: Q4. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026. Applicants must report to the venue along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG Degree/Diploma or an MBBS Degree from a recognized university along with at least 2 years of working experience in the concerned discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident positions is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per central government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: All other candidates who do not fall under the exempted categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- through a Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q8. Are female candidates and SC/ST applicants exempted from the fee?
faq.answer: Yes, application fees for SC/ST, PWD, Female candidates, and Ex-Servicemen are completely Nil as per the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What salary is offered to Junior and Senior Specialists?
faq.answer: Junior Specialists receive a salary of Rs. 1,48,263/- per month, whereas Senior Specialists are entitled to a monthly salary of Rs. 1,72,572/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: Candidates must report to the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Sec-3, Plot No.41 IMT Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana on the interview date.
